title: Private Idol Disc: Tokubetsu-hen: Cosplayers
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ 【特別編】 ～コスプレイヤーズ～
overview: Private Idol Disc Tokubetsuhen: Cosplayers is a multimedia photobook of female cosplayers. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors style minigame themed like a 1-on-1 fighting game. Winning the minigame will unlock bonus videos.
